locked.text: ADMINISTRATOR'S TERMINAL. Locked to I. Osei.

choices.text: Break the lock. You are the auditor; arguably it is your job.

drafts.speaker: narrator
text: A folder of unsent messages, all addressed to the Combine board, all beginning the same way: 'I have to report a discovery beneath the Ithaca dig...' The oldest is eight months old. None was ever sent.

The newest is three lines long. 'If I tell them, they take it and us with it. If I do not, I am lying to the people who pay for our air. There is a third option in the charter, Clause Nine, and I am too tired to be that brave.'
